cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
cards.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. What time did the kitchen light go off after the extra dinner plate was used?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why don't you ask who came over?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'd like to understand the timetable first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then which bus carried the timetable's missing person home?

mechanism: A conducts the questioning and determines which surrounding details B may answer, pursuing a visitor identity without directly requesting the name.
confusable: Distinguish euphemistically asking who from actually eliciting circumstantial clues while refusing the direct identity question.
comparison: Tea traces ask service preferences; late dinner traces ask travel timing. Both must pursue the same hidden visitor rather than random suspicion.
seedUse: Read canonical coat/cup and dinner/timetable seeds critically: their indirectness cannot excuse a direct who question or invented bus journey. Use S01 through control of the inquiry.
